findings.claim: `record_policy` is committed to the ledger (via `Ledger.record_policy`'s own `self._db.commit()`) *before* `reverify` is called on line 776, whose own adjacent comment states a gate that errors 'raises out of `reverify`: infrastructure, and never this task's MERGE_FAILED.' If that raise happens, the task's `policy_sha` has already been durably rewritten to the fetch_head declaration even though no gate suite was ever confirmed to have completed under it — violating the stated invariant that an `error` 'aborts the attempt, is never charged to the task' (§ Status). The write should follow a successful `reverify` return, not precede the call, so an errored re-verification leaves no residue in the ledger. Tests only exercise `reverify` mocked to always succeed, so this ordering defect is invisible to the gate suite.
